structure.unit: Requirements Applicable to Underground Coal Mines; Electricity, Safety, Etc
Ventilation, Mine Gases, and Other Hazardous Conditions

law.catch_line: Ventilation with air from certain areas
law.text: Active face workings shall not be ventilated with air that has passed through a worked-out area or has been used to ventilate a pillar line. This section shall not apply to air that is being used to ventilate an active pillar line or a room that is necessary to establish and maintain such pillar line.
